metadata.article_title: Vesting order in case of other property.

article.title: Vesting order in case of other property.
article.content: In the case of any movable property not hereinbefore provided for, the Court may make an order vesting such property in the purchaser or as he may direct; and such property shall vest accordingly.
article.html:
81Vesting order in case of other property.

Order 21, Rule 81

In the case of any movable property not hereinbefore provided for, the Court may make an order vesting such property in the purchaser or as he may direct; and such property shall vest accordingly.
